newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wearnes Tech sells shares to Tuan Sing subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Wearnes Tech sells shares to Tuan Sing subsidiary.

text.p: Singapore's WBL Corp Ltd said on Friday its subsidiary, Wearnes Technology, has sold all its shares in Omedata Singapore and P T Omedata for Singapore $5.935 million to a unit of Tuan Sing Holding Ltd.

WBL said in a statement it sold 75,000 ordinary shares of S$1 each in Omedata Singapore worth S$75,000 and 2,775,000 ordinary shares of Rupiah 415 each in P T Omedata for S$5.86 million to TS Technologies Pte Ltd.
The sale of the shares in the two companies will result in an extraordinary gain of $2.97 million, WBL said.
But there would be no material impact on the results of WBL Group for the financial year ending 30 September 1997, it added.
